arxiv-2203-16906.title: The harmonic maps compactification of Teichmüller spaces for punctured Riemann surfaces
arxiv-2203-16906.creator: Kento Sakai
arxiv-2203-16906.description: Abstract . Wolf gave a homeomorphism from the Teichmüller space to the space of quadratic differentials on a closed Riemann surface by using harmonic maps. Moreover, using harmonic maps rays, he gave a compactification of the Teichmüller space and show that it coincides with the Thurston compactification.

arxiv-2308-05966.title: On the Learning of Digital Self-Interference Cancellation in Full-Duplex Radios
arxiv-2308-05966.creator: Jungyeon Kim, Hyowon Lee, Heedong Do, Jinseok Choi
arxiv-2308-05966.description: Abstract Full-duplex communication systems have the potential to achieve significantly higher data rates and lower latency compared to their half-duplex counterparts. This advantage stems from their ability to transmit and receive data simultaneously. However, to enable successful full-duplex operation, the primary challenge lies in accurately eliminating strong self-interference (SI).

arxiv-2405-20712.title: Simulation of open quantum systems on universal quantum computers
arxiv-2405-20712.creator: Huan-Yu Liu, Xiaoshui Lin, Zhao-Yun Chen, Cheng Xue, Tai-Ping Sun, Qing-Song Li, Xi-Ning Zhuang, Yun-Jie Wang, Yu-Chun Wu, Ming Gong, Guo-Ping Guo
arxiv-2405-20712.description: Abstract The rapid development of quantum computers has enabled demonstrations of quantum advantages on various tasks. However, real quantum systems are always dissipative due to their inevitable interaction with the environment, and the resulting non-unitary dynamics make quantum simulation challenging with only unitary quantum gates.

arxiv-2409-17831.title: Asymptotically Optimal Hardness for k k -Set Packing and k k -Matroid Intersection
arxiv-2409-17831.creator: Euiwoong Lee, Ola Svensson, Theophile Thiery
arxiv-2409-17831.description: Abstract For any ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 , we prove that k k -Dimensional Matching is hard to approximate within a factor of k / ( 12 + ε ) k/(12+\varepsilon) for large k k unless 𝐍𝐏 ⊆ 𝐁𝐏𝐏 {\mathbf{NP}}\subseteq{\mathbf{BPP}} .

arxiv-2505-09231.title: Formation and Early Evolution of Protoplanetary Disks under Nonuniform Cosmic-Ray Ionization
arxiv-2505-09231.creator: Erika Nishio, Kengo Tomida, Yuki Kudoh, Shigeo S. Kimura
arxiv-2505-09231.description: Abstract Angular momentum transport by magnetic fields is important for formation and evolution of protoplanetary disks. The effects of magnetic fields are suppressed due to non-ideal magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) effects such as ambipolar diffusion and Ohmic dissipation, which depend on the degree of ionization.

arxiv-2506-12261.title: Strategic Vantage Selection for Learning Viewpoint-Agnostic Manipulation Policies
arxiv-2506-12261.creator: David S. Hippocampus
arxiv-2506-12261.description: Abstract Vision-based manipulation has shown remarkable success, achieving promising performance across a range of tasks. However, these manipulation policies often fail to generalize beyond their training viewpoints, which is a persistent challenge in achieving perspective-agnostic manipulation, especially in settings where the camera is expected to move at runtime.

arxiv-2506-14357.title: C C -self-adjoint contractive extensions of C C -symmetric non-densely defined contractions
arxiv-2506-14357.creator: Yury Arlinskiĭ, Konrad Schmüdgen
arxiv-2506-14357.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yury Arlinskiĭ, Konrad Schmüdgen. Given a conjugation (involution) C C on a Hilbert space, C C -self-adjoint contractive extensions of a non-densely defined C C -symmetric contraction are studied and parameterizations of all such extensions are obtained. As an application, a proof of an announced result of Glazman [ 14 ] on the existence of maximal dissipative C C -self-adjoint extensions of a densely defined C C -symmetric dissipative operator is given. AMS Subject Classification (2020) .

arxiv-2507-13713.title: Arithmetic monodromy of hyper-Kähler varieties over p p -adic fields
arxiv-2507-13713.creator: Kazuhiro Ito, Tetsushi Ito, Teruhisa Koshikawa, Teppei Takamatsu, Haitao Zou
arxiv-2507-13713.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kazuhiro Ito, Tetsushi Ito, Teruhisa Koshikawa, Teppei Takamatsu, Haitao Zou. In this paper, we study the p p -adic and ℓ \ell -adic monodromy operators associated with hyper-Kähler varieties over p p -adic fields, in connection with Looijenga–Lunts–Verbitsky Lie algebras. We investigate a conjectural relation between the nilpotency indices of these monodromy operators on higher-degree cohomology groups and on the second cohomology, which may be viewed as an arithmetic analogue of Nagai’s conjecture for degenerations of hyper-Kähler manifolds over a disk.

britannica-1911-missi-dominici.title: Missi Dominici (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-missi-dominici.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-missi-dominici.description: Article 'Missi Dominici' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. by the Frankish kings and emperors to supervise the administration of their dominions. Their institution dates from Charles Martel and Pippin the Short, who sent out officials to see their orders executed. When Pippin became king in 754 he sent out missi in a desultory fashion; but Charlemagne made them a regular part of his administration, and a capitulary issued about 802 gives a detailed account of their duties.

pmc-11351681.title: Low Levels of Adropin Predict Adverse Clinical Outcomes in Outpatients with Newly Diagnosed Prediabetes after Acute Myocardial Infarction
pmc-11351681.creator: Tetiana A. Berezina, Oleksandr O. Berezin, Uta C. Hoppe, Michael Lichtenauer, Alexander E. Berezin
pmc-11351681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Adropin—a multifunctional peptide with tissue-protective capacity that regulates energy homeostasis, sensitivity to insulin and inflammatory response—seems to show an inverse association with the presence of cardiovascular and renal diseases, obesity and diabetes mellitus in the general population. The purpose of the study is to elucidate whether adropin may be a plausible predictive biomarker for clinical outcomes in post-ST elevation of myocardial infarction (STEMI) patients with newly diagnosed prediabetes according to the American Diabetes Association criteria.

pmc-11438164.title: Bivalirudin versus heparin in patients with or without bail-out GPI use: a pre-specified subgroup analysis from the BRIGHT-4 trial
pmc-11438164.creator: Jia Liao, Miaohan Qiu, Xiaojian Feng, Kui Chen, Dingbao Zhang, Yuncheng Zou, Xiaohui Zheng, Gang Zhao, Nailiang Tian, Zeqi Zheng, Xiaoping Peng, Qing Yang, Zhenyang Liang, Yi Li, Yaling Han, Gregg W. Stone
pmc-11438164.description: BackgroundConflicting results comparing bivalirudin versus heparin anticoagulation in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) undergoing primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), in part due to the confounding effect of glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (GPI). The aim of the study was to compare the safety and effectiveness of bivalirudin plus a post-PCI high-dose infusion vs heparin with or without bail-out GPI use.

pmc-12384860.title: Role of Tpm Isoforms Produced by the TPM4 Gene in the Regulation of Actin Filament Dynamics by Cofilin
pmc-12384860.creator: Svetlana G Roman, Victoria V Nefedova, Alexander M Matyushenko, Alla S Kostyukova
pmc-12384860.description: The actin cytoskeleton determines a huge number of intracellular processes, as well as maintaining the cell shape, transport, formation of intercellular contacts, etc. The actin cytoskeleton’s function is largely determined by actin-binding proteins. Here, the mutual influence of two actin-binding proteins, cofilin (cof) and tropomyosin (Tpm), is studied.

pmc-12558733.title: Neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy in patients with locally advanced squamous head and neck cancer: A retrospective study
pmc-12558733.creator: Qiu-Yi Huang, Ling-Feng Xu, Yuan Wu, Jian Chen
pmc-12558733.description: BackgroundThe conventional approach for the treatment of locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) entails the combination of surgery with radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy. However, the survival rate of patients has not improved. This is frequently attributed to the strong invasive and metastatic capabilities of the tumor, which makes it prone to recurrence.

pmc-12691726.title: General Self-Efficacy Among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care Units in Tunisia and Its Association with Family Quality of Life: A Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12691726.creator: Maha Dardouri, Fatma Korbi, Hajer I Motakef, Hamdi Lamine, Shaima Mohammed Nageeb, Bushra Alshammari, Sihem Chahed, Martin Rusnák, Imen Ayouni, Georgios Iatrakis
pmc-12691726.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The prevalence of low general self-efficacy (GSE) among pregnant women was notably high, particularly among those with at least one child.Age, rural area, planned pregnancy, family quality of life, parenting, and family material well-being were predictors of GSE among pregnant women. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-12764471.title: Duration of recovery from severe acute malnutrition and associated factors in children aged 6–59 months: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12764471.creator: Hikma Fedlu, Lata Fekadu, Amanuel Mengistu Merera, Kumara Asafa, Firew Tiruneh
pmc-12764471.description: Malnutrition, particularly severe acute malnutrition (SAM) in children under five, is a global crisis affecting 25–35 million children, especially in Africa and Southeast Asia. In Ethiopia, 21% are underweight, 36% stunted, and 7% wasted. This study assesses recovery time from SAM in children admitted to public hospitals in Jimma Town.

pmc-13121149.title: Bosworth fracture-dislocation of the ankle: a case report and literature review
pmc-13121149.creator: Shun Lin, Hang Zhuo, Yan Gong, Xueqiang Shen, Xiaochun Li, Zhiqiang Wang
pmc-13121149.description: IntroductionBosworth fracture-dislocation is a rare and specific variant of ankle injury. Its insidious radiographic features frequently lead to a high clinical misdiagnosis rate. Furthermore, the entrapment of the proximal fibular fracture fragment behind the posterolateral tibial ridge or the posterior malleolar fragment makes closed reduction exceptionally difficult.

pmc-13362173.title: Characterization of the Acinetobacter baumannii Secretome Using Size-Exclusion Chromatography and Raman Spectroscopy
pmc-13362173.creator: Elizaveta Alekseevna Denisova, Anastasia Avdyusheva, Elizaveta Tyshchuk, Polina Grebenkina, Andrey Korenevsky, Ivan Chelibanov, Vladimir Chelibanov, Areg Totolian, Lyudmila Kraeva, Vitaly Nazarov, Dmitry Sokolov
pmc-13362173.description: Acinetobacter baumannii, a multidrug-resistant pathogen of critical priority within the ESKAPE group, poses a significant threat to global healthcare, particularly in the context of nosocomial infections. Its pathogenesis is mediated not only by antibiotic resistance determinants but also by a complex repertoire of secreted virulence factors. However, comprehensive characterization of the A.

pmc-13436829.title: Compassion-based positive psychology group intervention (CB-PPGI) for individuals with personality disorders awaiting intensive treatment: a mixed-methods study of preliminary outcomes and acceptability
pmc-13436829.creator: Amber Hulskotte, Katinka Franken, Klaas Huijbregts, Peter M. ten Klooster, Gerben J. Westerhof, Ernst T. Bohlmeijer
pmc-13436829.description: IntroductionA compassion-based positive psychology group intervention (CB PPGI) is a promising approach to supporting personal recovery and mental wellbeing in individuals with severe mental health difficulties.MethodsThis mixed-methods study examined the preliminary outcomes and acceptability of an 8-week CB PPGI in 18 adults with personality disorders (PD) awaiting intensive treatment.

pmc-13456935.title: Dysmenorrhea and Absence of Restorative Sleep
pmc-13456935.creator: Keiko Takata, Kazuhiko Kotani, Hitoshi Umino
pmc-13456935.description: BackgroundDysmenorrhea negatively affects daily functioning; however, its association with restorative sleep remains undetermined, while sleep-related health is a recent topic. This study investigated whether there is an association between dysmenorrhea severity and the absence of restorative sleep in women.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 2,752 women of 18–56 years of age who underwent health-screening.
